content.text: Help me write the release notes; follow docs/style-guide.md.

value.content: # Style guide. Use the Oxford comma. Prefer the active voice. Address the reader as you. Keep sentences under twenty-five words. Never start a sentence with Simply.

content.text: Draft: v2.4 makes compaction faster. You can now run the compactor on a schedule, and the new log line shows what it dropped. It is quieter and, we think, kinder to your token budget.
